نبتعث (form VIII)
# نَبْتَعِثُ (nabtaʕiṯu) /nab.ta.ʕi.θu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# نُبْتَعَثُ (nubtaʕaṯu) /nub.ta.ʕa.θu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# نَبْتَعِثَ (nabtaʕiṯa) /nab.ta.ʕi.θa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# نُبْتَعَثَ (nubtaʕaṯa) /nub.ta.ʕa.θa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
